subject: Re: Compliance ops bundle — true‑up / annual billing approach
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@mednexa.com>

Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@mednexa.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Packaging & billing — compliance bundle + annual true‑up ask

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo this week — our security team liked the audit log pipeline and the built‑in KV encryption options. A couple things we need to align on for procurement to move forward:

- We prefer annual true‑up billing for add‑ons (audit logs, KMS seats, HSM) rather than monthly per‑GB billing. Would appreciate a mechanism to true up usage vs committed units once per year.
- Audit log retention: Security wants 7 years for specific audit trails (legal), but we could accept 2 years if there's an expandable option with a capped incremental cost.
- KMS/HSM: We need at least one dedicated HSM seat + KMS key seats, but we expect to ramp over the first 12 months. Can you propose pricing that amortizes implementation and includes a seat for year 1?
- Finally, Mednexa needs a one‑time onboarding credit or waiver for the implementation fee — procurement is pushing for this as a close condition.

Attached: Mednexa_RQ.pdf (compliance checklist), Compliance_Pricing_Sheet.xlsx (their internal cost model).

Do you have a sample true‑up clause you can share and a fast path to provide a capped per‑GB rate if we exceed the committed amount?

Best,
Jordan

Hi Jordan —

Appreciate the clear ask and the checklist — very helpful. Looping in Ben (pricing) and Laura (legal) to confirm options. High level thoughts up front:

- We can support an annual true‑up model. Typical pattern: customers commit to an annual baseline for add‑on units (audit log GBs, KMS seats, HSM seats). Usage above the baseline is billed at an overage rate but settled once a year (true‑up) with a floor/ceiling to reduce variability.
- For audit logs: we offer a 2‑year retention included in the compliance bundle; 7 year retention can be enabled as an add‑on or via cold‑storage export. We can propose a capped incremental price per GB/year for retention beyond 2 years.
- For HSM: we can include one HSM seat for year 1 if Mednexa commits to a 12‑month paid term for Dedicated/Private capacity; implementation fees are usually one‑time, but we have flexibility on credits for pilots or larger commitments.

Ben — see Jordan's attachments and RQ. Can you draft two options we can send back to Mednexa: (A) 12‑mo commitment with 1 HSM seat included + 15% compliance bundle discount + annual true‑up with 20% overage cap; (B) 24‑mo commitment with lower per‑unit rates and 1 HSM + 2 KMS seats included, but smaller onboarding credit.

Jordan — if you can share expected first‑year audit log GBs and an HSM ramp profile (months to add seats), we can tailor numbers.

Thanks,
Logan
Logan Wright

Logan — thanks for pulling this together. Based on Jordan's ask and our current packaging, here's a clean, defensible reply we can send to Mednexa (numbers are illustrative — will finalize after Jordan sends expected usage):

Option A — 12‑month commitment (recommended for speed to close)
- Compliance Bundle: 2‑year audit log retention included (up to 25 TB/year).
- HSM: 1 dedicated HSM seat included year 1 (provisioned in Private deployment). Additional HSM seats billed at $28,000/seat/year.
- KMS seats: 1 included, additional at $4,500/seat/year.
- Annual true‑up: customer commits to baseline units (audit log GBs + seats). We true up annually; overage rate = 1.25x committed per‑unit rate, but we will cap the annual overage spend for the first true‑up at 20% of committed spend to reduce volatility.
- Onboarding: waive the standard implementation fee for customers who commit to this 12‑month plan OR provide a $25k onboarding credit applied to month 1 invoice.
- Discount: 15% off list for the Compliance Bundle line items (applies to audit log storage, KMS/HSM seats) for the 12‑month term.

Option B — 24‑month commitment (better economics)
- Same technical coverage; 1 HSM + 2 KMS seats included.
- Audit log retention baseline increased to 40 TB/year.
- Discount: 22% off list for compliance items.
- Onboarding credit: $12k (reduced because of longer term).

Notes for legal: Laura, we should add explicit language for the annual true‑up timing (calendar day vs anniversary), an overage cap clause (first true‑up capped at 20%), and a data‑retention escalation path for audit logs that requires 30 days notice.

If we send Option A with the waived onboarding fee and an explicit first‑year overage cap, I think procurement will sign quickly.

—Ben

Proposal (12‑month commitment — recommended)
- Compliance Bundle (applies to audit logs and compliance tooling): 15% discount on list prices for audit log storage and KMS/HSM seats for 12 months.
- Audit log retention: 2 years included up to 25 TB/year. Extended retention to 7 years available via cold archive export at $0.08/GB/year (capped at $30k/year until first true‑up).
- HSM/KMS: 1 HSM seat included year 1; additional HSM seats $28,000/seat/year. 1 KMS seat included; additional KMS seats $4,500/seat/year.
- Annual true‑up: true‑up occurs on the contract anniversary. Overage billing applies at 1.25x committed per‑unit rate, with the first annual true‑up overage capped at 20% of committed spend.
- Onboarding: we will waive the standard implementation fee (or alternatively apply a $25,000 onboarding credit) if you sign the 12‑month commitment within 5 business days of this email.
- Deliverables: updated SOW (attached), Compliance_Bundle_Pricing_v3.xlsx with line‑item math.

Next steps: please confirm estimated first‑year audit log volume (GB) and expected HSM ramp (if you expect to add more seats month‑by‑month). Once we have that, we will send a DocuSign package for signature (SOW + Order Form).

If procurement prefers the 24‑month option for better unit economics, we can share that term sheet as well.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this for Mednexa.
